problems.title: Lemma17 loses the square root in converting cosine deficit to direction error
problems.assumptions: Exact balanced unit neurons, orthonormal centers, all-neuron alignment, positive nu,zeta, correct cluster masses
problems.check: Independent auxiliary exact-rational witness and separate parent Fraction recomputation; original pages visually inspected
problems.counterevidence: Not a sampled GF trajectory; stronger dynamical estimates could salvage theorem; corrected O(sqrt(delta)) lemma is valid
problems.impact: Published deduction of core uniform Otilde(alpha0^2) rate is invalid
problems.correction: Use K(1+nu)p sqrt(2delta)+Knu+zeta under all-neuron alignment; generic sphere bound Otilde(K alpha0) and conditional radius deficit Otilde(K^(1/p) alpha0^(1/p)); fixed-K simplification explicit; full dynamical rate unresolved.

focused_check.note: Verified all-neuron admissibility of the balanced D=3, K=2, p=3 witness, including unit norms, cluster masses and nu=zeta=t^4. Its error about 0.0017313 exceeds the claimed bound about 0.000056 by 30.916 times. The omitted square root is used on the core uniform-rate path, supporting Major without claiming a failed sampled gradient-flow trajectory. The local replacement retains explicit K dependence.

problems.title: Robustness proof uses incorrect input homogeneity
problems.claim: Degree-one scaling of Fp and network; off-sphere error at most norm(x)nu
problems.assumptions: p3; degree-one f=norm(x)^(1-p)Fp; zero sphere discrepancy; nu=.001 admissible
problems.check: Definition-level homogeneity calculation, explicit x=2e1 discrepancy6 >.002; parent visual and arithmetic checks
problems.result: EqD2 inference false; degree-p network fails stated degree-one premise
problems.counterevidence: Positive radial rescaling preserves signs; replacement degree-p extension and margin argument recover robustness probability form
problems.impact: Invalid proof on central convergence-to-robustness dependency, without disproving robustness principle
problems.core_dependency: Proposition3 connects approximation to main robustness claim
problems.correction: Degree-p radial extension with norm(z)^p nu, uniform deterministic margin and Gaussian-mgf tail; this repairs the local robustness bridge under its stated conditions, not P1 or the full trajectory theorem.

focused_check.note: Verified the stated degree-one premise versus actual degree-p network/target and the off-sphere 2-versus-8 witness. The core robustness bridge contains an invalid derivation, supporting Major. Positive radial scaling preserves classification signs; the degree-p radial extension, deterministic margin and Gaussian-tail repair are bounded counterevidence, not certification of the unrepaired main approximation rate.

repair_verification: Local square-root Lipschitz correction and radial-rescaling margin argument checked. No repaired full GF theorem or author adoption claimed.
